exposure: Absence of maternal diseases during pregnancy
neonatal feeding type (exclusive breastfeeding, breast plus formula feeding, pure formula feeding)
cohort: 183,449 primary and middle school students in Guangzhou, China
finding: Several prenatal and neonatal factors, including male sex, high birth weight, cesarean delivery, and father smoking status, were associated with an increased risk of allergic diseases in school children.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of asthma, dermatitis, rhinitis, and eczema in school children.
